name: zgeometry_clip_patch_output_destroy
description: zGeometry_ClipPatchOutput::Destroy frees the partition array when present and then frees the output header.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient/zGeometry clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46af20 validates optional free of self->partitions followed by free(self).
The native zDEClient feature leaf smoke allocates a clip-patch output, installs a partition allocation, and destroys it through the production helper.
